entries.title: Psalms 83:1
segments: A Song. A Psalm of Asaph. Keep not silence, O God; do not be speechless, and be not still, O God.

entries.title: Psalms 83:2
segments: For lo, Your enemies roar; and those who hate You have lifted up their head.

entries.title: Psalms 83:3
segments: They take shrewd counsel against Your people, and plot against Your hidden ones.

entries.title: Psalms 83:4
segments: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from [being] a nation, so that the name Israel may be remembered no more.

entries.title: Psalms 83:5
segments: For with one heart they have plotted together; they have made a covenant against You--

entries.title: Psalms 83:6
segments: the tents of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarites;

entries.title: Psalms 83:7
segments: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the people of Tyre;

entries.title: Psalms 83:8
segments: and Assyria has joined with them; they have helped the sons of Lot. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 83:9
segments: Do to them as [to] Midian, as [to] Sisera, as [to] Jabin at the torrent Kishon;

entries.title: Psalms 83:10
segments: who perished at Endor; they became [as] dung for the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 83:11
segments: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb; yea, all their princes like Zebah, and like Zalmunna;

entries.title: Psalms 83:12
segments: who said, Let us take possession for ourselves of the houses of God.

entries.title: Psalms 83:13
segments: O my God, make them like a wheel; like the stubble before the wind.

entries.title: Psalms 83:14
segments: As the fire burns a forest, and as the flame sets the mountains on fire,

entries.title: Psalms 83:15
segments: so pursue them with Your tempest, and make them afraid with Your storm.

entries.title: Psalms 83:16
segments: Fill their faces with shame, that they may seek Your name, O LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 83:17
segments: Let them be ashamed and troubled forever; yea, let them be put to shame, and lost;

entries.title: Psalms 83:18
segments: so that [men] may know that Your name is JEHOVAH, that You alone [are] the Most High over all the earth.
